textrules.title: Texting rules, and why
textrules.intro: Every text PolishOS sends follows these rules. Each one says who made it, so you always know why a text did or didn't go out.
textrules.note: Plain-words summary, not legal advice. Rules can change; we'll tell you in the app when they do.

law.who: Made by the government (FCC, TCPA law, state laws)
law.title: Ask first, stop when asked, not at night
items: A client gets texts only after they said yes. For promos the yes must be written (a checkbox they tick). PolishOS saves when, where and the exact words.
STOP stops every text from your salon at once. A client can also say stop any other way ("don't text me" at the desk): untick texts on their profile the same day.
No texts at night: reminders wait until 8 AM, promos only 9 AM–8 PM your salon's time (some states are stricter).
Every promo says who it's from and how to stop.
law.why: Breaking these can cost a business $500–$1,500 per text in lawsuits. Nobody can switch them off.

carriers.who: Made by the phone carriers (AT&T, T-Mobile, Verizon) and Twilio
carriers.title: Every business number is registered
items: Client texts go out only from your salon's own number, registered in your business name ("10DLC"). Review takes about 1–3 weeks.
The registration says what you text (reminders, receipts, promos). Promos are never sent on a number registered for notices only.
No texts about alcohol, tobacco, firearms, adult content or hate. No free short links like bit.ly.
Landlines can't get texts; a phone that's off gets it later or not at all. We show the carrier's reason.
carriers.why: Carriers block or slow down numbers that break these, for everyone on them. That's why staff invites come from the PolishOS number and client texts from yours.

stripe.title: Card money stays separate
items: Stripe moves card money only. It never sees your clients' texts.
Promo credit is paid by card like your plan, and shows on your receipts.
Clients are never charged a card fee in a text or on the pay page.
stripe.why: Keeps money and messages apart: a texting problem never touches your card payments.

polishos.who: Made by PolishOS (to keep it fair and clear)
polishos.title: No surprises
items: Reminders, confirmations and receipts are included in your plan and never stop, even when promo credit is empty.
Promos use prepaid credit (2¢ per text part). You see the cost and who gets it before every send, and never half a send.
At most 1 promo per client per day.
Every text and email is listed in Messages with what happened.
polishos.why: So you always know what was sent, what it cost and why.
